text:
emma: Heads-up 1: quick design pass requested on the Private Setup wizard's connectivity card. Goals: make failure actions obvious, clarify report download naming, and ensure keyboard/voiceflow for expanded details. Posting mock in Figma plus probe sample.

 diego: Love it. Two immediate asks: 1) add a microcopy variant for mobile narrow widths, 2) avoid using the word 'failed' alone 1 it's alarming. Maybe use 'Connection issue' as the pill label.

 rachel: Agreed on copy. Also let's make the primary action 'Run diagnostics' and keep 'Download report' as the tertiary action in the details pane. For naming, prefer: priv-probe-report-<cluster>-YYYYMMDDT[time].json so customers can easily correlate.

 vikram: Implementation note: the probe runner returns structured results and a small artifact URL when available. Example payload we return to Console:

 ```json
 {
  "status": "ssh_unreachable",
  "latency_ms": null,
  "artifact_url": "https://s3.redwood.internal/probes/priv-probe-abc123.json",
  "checks": [
    {"id": "dns", "label": "DNS lookup", "ok": true},
    {"id": "egress_443", "label": "Outbound 443", "ok": true},
    {"id": "ssh_22", "label": "SSH handshake", "ok": false, "hint": "No TCP SYN+ACK from bastion.example:22"}
  ]
 }
 ```

 diego: Thanks 1 on the UI side, map the hint to friendly text: "No TCP response from bastion.example:22 1 check bastion host & inbound rules." Each hint should have a small KB link anchor `#ssh-troubleshooting`.

 emma: Accessibility checklist from me:
 - announce probe result via aria-live when it finishes (success: polite, error: assertive)
 - the status pill should have role=status and aria-live updates plus an off-screen label prefix "Probe:" for screen readers
 - when user opens details, move focus to heading and put focusable Close button at the end (Shift+Tab returns to details toggle)
 - ensure expand/collapse is keyboard operable (Enter/Space) and has aria-expanded on the toggle

 rachel: UX detail: collapsed view shows one-line summary: pill, short message like "Check failed: SSH" and a small latency tag if present. The action row on the right should contain the primary `Run diagnostics` button and a secondary small icon button `?` that opens contextual help.

 vikram: Regarding backoff, we should disable the Run button for 3s after click and show a micro toast: "Running diagnostics..." with spinner in the button. If consecutive failures exceed 3 within 15 minutes, show an escalation CTA: "Contact support with report" which attaches the artifact automatically.

 diego: Visual idea: use a left accent color band for the expanded card tied to the status (green/yellow/red) and a small chevron that rotates when expanded. On mobile, hide the latency to save space and collapse the action row into an overflow menu.

 emma: Microcopy proposals:
 - success pill: "Connected \u2014 egress OK"
 - partial: "Partial connectivity \u2014 diagnostics"
 - ssh fail: "Connection issue \u2014 run diagnostics"
 Longer explainer in the details panel. For the download action use label `Download probe report` (explicit).

 rk-bot: [artifact available] 2184550155 1 probe artifact uploaded: priv-probe-report-clusterA-20260323T174955.json

 rachel: Nice. Also, when user downloads the JSON, offer a one-click copy of recommended local troubleshooting commands. Example copyable commands: `ssh -vvv bastion.example -p 22` and `curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/health`. No heavy logs in UI, but allow download.

 vikram: Security note: artifact URLs are short-lived and signed. The UI should use a temporary fetch token and not expose internal S3 links directly. Also sanitize the JSON before offering to download (strip any internal trace ids).

 emma: For QA: we'll need keyboard walkthroughs, NVDA checks for aria-live announcements, and a mobile test for the overflow actions. Assignments: diego will update the Figma with mobile variants, rachel will draft the microcopy variants and download name pattern, vikram will add artifact naming + backoff logic. I'll compile the accessibility checklist into the component ticket.

 diego: I'll also mock an animation for chevron + height change and attach a video.

 rachel: I'll write the KB anchors: #ssh-troubleshooting, #egress-ports, #how-to-run-local-probe and link them from the detail hints. Links open in new tab with rel=noopener noreferrer.

 emma: Thanks all 1 closing this review. Reopen if anyone runs into edgecases.
